blocking: Covariate set does not include the LCL outcome's own baseline. dpc1_lcl_ko = ko - wt with wt = pc1_lcl_base, but pc1_lcl_base is not a covariate, and pc1_cm_base is dropped when it is X. Any global change in compartment strength (KO eigenvector amplitude != WT) makes dpc1_lcl_ko track -wt, so every architecture-linked predictor (pc1_cm_base, cpg_n, giemsa, tss_count, lamina) can 'confirm' on even chromosomes for a trivial scaling reason. That contradicts covariate_note ('change beyond baseline genome architecture'). Repair: add pc1_lcl_base as a covariate for pairs whose Y (or X) is dpc1_lcl_ko, in config and in screen.py, and add a synthetic test where Y = s*Z + noise and X correlates with Z, asserting that the partial rho is near 0. dpc1_cm_r225x is already adjusted for pc1_cm_base, except in pairs where pc1_cm_base is X (excluded same-source) and in the dlam_mCh/siScr_mCh pairs, which are fine.
minor: discovery.json 'all' holds rho and p for every pair; stdout prints counts only. Run discovery and 'freeze.py survivors' back to back without opening discovery.json, or write 'all' to a separate file opened only after the survivor freeze.
confirm mode does not check that config, features, code and survivors match freeze-pre-discovery.json and freeze-survivors.json. Add a sha check, or make it an explicit run step, before confirm.

freeze.py pre-discovery does not bind this review, features/tiles.base.tsv, data/external/* (gc5Base.bw is recorded only by size) or the Python/numpy/scipy versions. The survivors stage does not re-verify that the pre-discovery hashes still match.
Discovery p = min(p_neg, p_pos) with no doubling, so the effective two-sided selection alpha is 0.02. That is acceptable for selection, but record it as intended.
The circular shift allows offsets of 1 tile. Near-identity shifts make the null conservative (they cost power; they do not inflate false positives). Consider a minimum offset of about 10 tiles.
Complete-case filtering collapses NaN gaps before the shift. The shift is over the remaining tiles, not the genomic ring. This is acceptable, but document it.

The (lfc_cm_h222p, lfc_ipsc_silmna) pair and other lfc pairs may fall below min_n=800 in one half (each lfc has about 2.6k finite tiles genome-wide). That fails silently. Per-pair n is recorded, so no change is needed; note it in the report.

lfc outcomes have no baseline-expression covariate. A pseudocount of 1 CPM makes the tile LFC depend on expression level. This is partly absorbed by tss_count, gc and pc1_cm_base. Note it as a residual confound.
GSE126459 HOMER PC1 is assumed to be hg38. The chr1 last bin end (248.5 Mb) cannot distinguish the builds. Cite the GEO or prior-campaign record for the build.
Liftover is in the correct direction (hg38 tile midpoint to hg19, same chromosome required). Several hg38 tiles can map to one hg19 bin, which duplicates values; this is minor.
excluded_pairs matching is order-sensitive. It is correct for the current lists, but it is safer to compare unordered pairs (frozenset).
The synthetic tests never exercise covariates. The null test uses 4 seeds with 200 shifts.
notes: Tests pass (5/5). The config yields 47 unordered pairs, so k <= 47 and alpha/k >= 0.00106 > 1/5001. Confirmation is always reachable; it would become impossible only if k > 250. Selection (|rho| >= 0.08, p <= 0.01, n >= 800) and confirmation (same sign, sign*rho >= 0.05, one-sided p <= 0.05/k with 5000 shifts) are coherent, and the lower confirm threshold allows for winner's-curse shrinkage. Rank-partial Spearman is correct: ranks are taken within the half on complete cases, X and Y are regressed on an intercept plus covariate ranks, residuals are correlated, and X is re-residualized after each shift. The null shifts X within chromosome with Y and Z fixed, so chromosome-level confounding is preserved. Directional p uses (1+count)/(1+n). No path lets even-chromosome values reach selection; confirmation reads only the survivor list. Feature code checks: HOMER 500 kb bin keys, genePred TSS by strand, CPM log2((b+1)/(a+1)) with mutant/knockdown over control, and correct control/mutant column selection by header. Own-pc1 LCL tracks are oriented by gene density. Reviewer did not read feature values or compute any correlations.
